title: Replace a cartridge in a ratchet-rod dispenser
instruction: Replace the used orange cartridge with the prepared blue cartridge. Leave the used cartridge in the collection tray and the dispenser resting in its cradle, with the replacement seated and the piston rod re-engaged at its rear. The rod handle may remain extended behind the dispenser. Release both hands.
context: Consumable replenishment at an assembly or repair bench: disengage and retract a tool piston, exchange its cartridge, then restore the mechanical working configuration. Use inert practice cartridges.
setup: Calibrated YAM station: wooden tabletop 1100 x 1300 x 60 mm, top z=747.5 mm; arm bases at (0,+/-305,750) mm. Coordinates: x forward, y left, z up. Free unpowered steel/polymer dispenser, about 62 x 333 x 141 mm at reset, 494 g including its 1 g noncolliding internal carrier, frame origin (320,-30,880) mm. A reusable 12 mm diameter x 29 mm outlet is fixed ahead of the front plate; its 16 mm diameter x 12 mm seat and 22 x 12 x 8 mm bridge remain on the tool. Rod and cartridge axes point +y; all joints start at zero. Orange used polymer practice cartridge: maximum diameter 49 mm, tube length 200 mm, 200 mm overall with flush front face, no projecting tip, 45 g, spawned at (320,82,880) mm, supported coaxially by two steel bridges (50 x 18 x 5.5 mm) on the dispenser at local y=55/180 mm; bridge tops are 24.5 mm below the piston axis. Blue prepared replacement: same outer geometry, fixed rear practice piston, 160 g, centre (180,400,772.5) mm. Fixed polymer tool cradle: 112 x 210 x 6 mm foot centred (320,87.5,750.5) mm; four 12 x 18 x 90.5 mm posts and two 80 x 18 x 12 mm crossbars at y=25 and 150 mm, top z=850 mm; four 8 x 24 x 18 mm visible locating edges at x=284/356, y=25/150, z=853 mm leave 1 mm lateral rail clearance. The tool remains free to lift out. Two fixed spare-guide rails, each 8 x 220 x 12 mm, centres (150,400,753.5) and (210,400,753.5) mm. Fixed polymer collection tray: 118 x 288 x 20 mm overall, centred x=430,y=400 mm, floor top z=751.5 mm, 102 x 272 mm inner opening. No wet adhesive or cutting tools. scene-inventory.json lists every solid, local transform, aggregate mass, material and joint; setup-layout.json gives the station and spawn poses. Both arms start ready with open grippers; settle 0.5 s before the initial image. No layout randomization.
scoring: Final current state; peak credit is not retained. Permanent zero if any moving task solid leaves table x=-190..910 mm or y=-650..650 mm, goes below z=741.5 mm, or has nonfinite geometry. Otherwise: 0.25 if the complete used cartridge lies within 50 mm in x and 135 mm in y of the tray centre, its centre is within 25 mm in x/y and 8 mm of z=776.5 mm, abs(axis_z)<0.1 and linear speed<20 mm/s. With that collection, 0.5 if the replacement centre is within 6 mm on each axis of frame-local (0,112,0) mm, its axis error<0.10 rad pointing +y and speed<20 mm/s. With both, 0.75 if the piston face is from 1 mm beyond to 5 mm behind the rear piston, rod rotation is within 0.15 rad of teeth-down zero and pawl angle within 0.12 rad of zero. Score 1.0 if these conditions plus frame origin within 20 mm of (320,-30,880) mm, frame orientation error<=10 degrees, frame speed<20 mm/s, both gripper openings>=70 mm and every robot collision envelope at least 30 mm from all moving task envelopes hold continuously for 1 s. All other outcomes score zero. Scoring at 20 Hz; geometry escape audit at 240 Hz. Read README for envelope definitions and real-world measurement.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz (120 seconds), fixed layout, seed 0.
reset_notes: Restore all spawn poses and zero joint positions from setup-layout.json and scene-inventory.json; return the inert cartridges to their stated positions and let the native scene settle for 0.5 s. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Custom primitive dispenser with a fixed outlet and plain rigid cylindrical refills. Native PhysX contacts at 240 Hz, YAM control/scoring at 20 Hz. Passive ratchet teeth/pawl, rod translation/rotation, bulkhead stop and seating. Nominal masses/friction; inert refills, replacement rear piston fixed. No fluid, dispensing pressure, trigger drive, material deformation, wear or damage model. No runtime apparatus pose writes or software unlocks.
